definitions.explanation: The act of putting on clothing in a store to check if it fits before purchasing.

examples.japanese: {試着|しちゃく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{試着室|しちゃくしつ}→試着室：09626_shichakushitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧です。
examples.english: The fitting room is over there.

examples.japanese: {試着|しちゃく}⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{小|ちい}さかった→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧。
examples.english: When I tried it on, it was smaller than I expected.

notes:
{試着|しちゃく} refers specifically to trying on clothing or accessories in a store before purchasing. It combines {試|し} (try, test) and ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (wearing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {試着|しちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to try on (clothes)
- {試着|しちゃく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: May I try this on? (standard polite request)
- {試着|しちゃく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みる: to try something on (tentatively)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{試着室|しちゃくしつ}→試着室：09626_shichakushitsu⟧: fitting room, changing room

SHOPPING NOTES:
In Japanese stores, always ask before trying on clothes. Some stores limit the number of items you can bring into the fitting room. Shoes can also be {試着|しちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

- ⟦{試食|ししょく}→試食：03060_shishoku⟧: food tasting
